body:
## Result and exact basis

Workflow-final-verification, governed-final, VP1B-final-readiness-boundary: success and branch-ready for the complete delivered initiative, including the user-authorized current-authority clarification and M3 marker rename/example. M1, M2 and M3 are completed. Independent current Design r8, Delivery r5, M3 Code Review and fresh final whole-change Code Review r3 support this distinct Verify; original seven findings remain reporter-resolved with no additional required correction. Earlier Verify objects remain exact historical evidence in prior-verify-d62fd3fa and prior-verify-f70b65f0 rather than being retargeted to revised subjects.

```yaml
verification_basis:
  repository_identity: R_kgDOSGsVUQ
  remote_identity: git@github.com:xiongxianfei/rigorloop.git
  base_branch: main
  base_revision: 56d8000ded3379a3c6796645826ce465175d75a3
  merge_base_revision: 56d8000ded3379a3c6796645826ce465175d75a3
  head_branch: proposal/unified-design-authoring
  verified_subject_revision: b2a610016f7c9d8ca2bf7705ed920c25ff7e95df
```

## What changed and why

The complete initiative replaces overlapping spec/architecture authors with one portable design skill; reconciles behavior, realization, rationale, boundaries and representative acceptance under living model owners; preserves independent affected-subject review and Delivery proof allocation; demonstrates bounded Design/System ownership migration; and supplies an explicitly authorized managed upgrade that avoids pre-deletion/lockfile drift traps. Local modifications, ambiguous ownership, independent writes and interrupted partial states remain protected. FU-012–014 retain later consolidation ownership. Release/customer adoption remain separate.

The subsequent RC consumer correction makes current v2-only authority and historical extraction meaning explicit. The latest user-requested M3 correction names the independent Markdown format model-document-v1, replacing the misleading document use of explicit-recording-v1. All seven current living-model declarations, the owning DES-SR-11 contract, Workflow/Record Format/boundary-method consumers, validator dispatch/diagnostic, skill resource and skeleton agree. Retired/unknown/missing/duplicate markers reject before table checks; no compatibility alias, new runtime record format or automatic customer-document migration is introduced. Stored records remain rigorloop-records-v2; independent targeted transport versions and historical bytes remain unchanged.

The owning Design includes an indexed complete illustrative label-normalization model: three local requirements, all eight scenario dimensions, synthetic scope and concrete outcomes. Leading/trailing ASCII spaces are removed, interior characters remain, all-space input yields an empty string, non-string input rejects without a normalized value, and the pure transformation has no external state effects. This is a structural/example contract, not a new production component or a claim that a label-normalization implementation was tested. The fence is ignored when validating the parent and is independently valid when extracted to its hypothetical model path. An edited relied-on example requires its owner's exact-subject reassessment.

## Authority and traceability

The accepted proposal remains the original direction basis. Explicit user authority selects the RC clarification and coordinated marker rename/example. Design r8 assesses the seven living models plus retained Target-native init; Delivery r5 approves the exact unchanged M1/M2 allocation plus M3 addendum and the all-in-scope-milestone final checkpoint. The plan maps M3 to DES-SR-09/11/12/16/19, new/retired/unknown marker proof, parent/example structural validation, aligned authoring/package consumers and revised-candidate walkthroughs. M1/M2 still realize the original DES/SYS/TNI/Workflow obligations and TG-01–07/TG-FINAL-01/02. No implementation requirement is inferred solely from the example, and no representative scenario becomes a test whitelist.

Current independent milestone and final reviews assess the actual changed model/resource/validator/metadata subjects and their interactions. The final review is a fresh complete-change assessment after all milestones, not a substituted milestone approval. Prior reviews and original historical records remain attached to their exact subjects. Original authoring evidence that was inconclusive before dispatch implementation retains that result; subsequent actual red/green checks establish the delivered support.

## Actual validation and evidence applicability

M3 tests-first evidence demonstrates two failing tests against old production dispatch: the retired marker was accepted and the new parent was rejected. After the bounded validator/resource change, ModelRecordTests and the complete boundary suite passed. New tests cover retired rejection before malformed-table checks, the extracted illustrative example, parent fence isolation, unknown marker rejection and current skill resource/skeleton declarations. Existing missing/duplicate/dimension/reference/path negative protection remains.

Actual commands after M3:

- python scripts/test-boundary-first-validation.py:89 passed.
- python scripts/test-skill-validator.py:355 passed.
- npm test --prefix packages/rigorloop:454 passed.
- python scripts/test-npm-package-publication.py:7 passed; python scripts/validate-npm-package.py passed.
- python scripts/validate-documentation-prose.py --mode enforce --path docs/design/design/design.md --path docs/plans/2026-09-08-unified-design-authoring-and-bounded-model-consolidation.md:0 errors/warnings.
- python scripts/validate-markdown-readability.py --generated-document docs/design/design/design.md docs/design/design/design.md:passed with54 nonblocking readability warnings, including the complete illustrative fence.
- Changed-path selector:14 maintained checks, no unclassified/blocked paths, broad_smoke_required:false. Every selected command actually passed: record-store schema check; all-seven-model structural validation; selected boundary consumer validation; boundary regression; canonical skills validation/regression/generation/drift; adapter archive-generation check; scoped lifecycle validation; change-metadata validation/regression; complete Node and npm publication suites. Exact commands/results are in model-marker-m3-checks.
- python scripts/build-adapters.py --version v0.5.1 --output-dir /tmp/rigorloop-model-document-candidate-weshsptv built actual current candidates. Existing archive-measurement helper generated current metadata and release-index digest; no archive bodies or historical metadata were hand-edited.
- python scripts/validate-adapters.py --version v0.5.1 --adapter-root /tmp/rigorloop-model-document-candidate-weshsptv --clean-install-smoke --skill design --skill design-review --skill plan passed for Codex, Claude and OpenCode.
- Fresh current record-store validation, Git diff whitespace, exact review/model/source identities, complete work/finding state, candidate hashes/sizes and branch/base/merge-base checks passed before recording.

The new mw-01-model-marker-refresh independently unpacks all three current candidates and exercises new-model creation, no-authority stop versus explicitly authorized old-marker-only editing, parent/extracted-example validation and changed-example/unchanged-parent exact handoff. It embeds substantive fixture, authority and outcome evidence. New mw-03-model-marker-candidate repeats the real CLI managed two-root OpenCode upgrade with a Codex neighbor, intact recorded old basis, external backup, process interruption, partial-retry rejection, complete original restoration and successful/idempotent retry against the new candidate. Installed ZIP bytes, backup hashes and unrelated content are independently compared. These current proofs replace reliance on old candidate identity for those paths.

Current candidate identities are recorded in model-marker-m3-checks and both refreshed walkthroughs and match the actual archives and generated metadata. Direct ZIP comparison shows identical entry sets; only design/assets/design-skeleton.md and design/references/model-authoring.md differ from the prior candidate in each adapter. All other installed methods, aliases and consumers remain byte-identical. This supports the reviewer's selective renewal of unchanged legacy/technical/common guidance meaning, not a claim to have reexecuted every old walkthrough step. Full previous158 adapter,156 selector and other unchanged infrastructure suites retain protection only for unchanged generator/selector code and unchanged affected method bytes; current candidate generation, clean installs, public upgrade, metadata/Node and directly affected source suites were run anew. No158-suite rerun is claimed.

## Impact and limitations

Affected: document-version dispatch and diagnostics; current model/consumer/example guidance; Design/Delivery basis; candidate package content/hashes; current review/evidence/work/Verify records. Direct proof and independent review cover these changes. Runtime storage schema, CLI transport, installer algorithms, trust/concurrency/recovery primitives, dependencies and external-service behavior are unchanged by M3, confirmed by actual diff and fresh full Node/candidate integration proof. The earlier managed-replacement implementation remains part of the complete verified initiative, with original helper/public negative proof and current integrated walkthrough coverage. No externally persisted data migration or new service is introduced.

Historical Target-native init retains13 baseline full-file prose-wrap findings, previously byte/message-compared and unchanged; no full-file prose pass is claimed. Earlier architecture-method marker failures were fixed by bounded immutable-retirement validation and tests. Current grandfathered-spec structural review observations are satisfied by independent Design classification; structural checks alone are not approval. Readability warnings do not weaken semantic/example obligations. The old explicit-recording-v1 name remains only where it identifies retired/historical contracts or supplies a negative test, not as a live model declaration or current authoring instruction.

Release-only V9 remains not-run under its unchanged explicit publication trigger; V5/V8 candidate proof is complete. No release, merge, publication or customer adoption is claimed. Hosted CI passed for prior PR headf70b65f0cc95608329d9ed8053511647f1a3b7a5 (run34281640086), not this changed head. New-head hosted CI remains unobserved before push. User authorization to continue through the existing PR permits a separate fast-forward handoff after exact remote and evidence-suffix checks. Existing PR body may remain as the original initiative description; the linked current Verify and owning Design provide the exact refinement and example.
